scope.constructor_inputs: the multiset of exact common-input TIFF byte strings for one capture
scope.denominator_invariance_test: changing any stacker output while holding the common-input TIFF bytes fixed must leave the overlap manifest byte-identical

registration.descriptor: SIFT descriptor rounded ties-to-even and clipped to uint8

match.split_order: SHA256(M193-LANDMARK-SPLIT-V1 NUL || four signed big-endian Q8 coordinates || both descriptors)

fit.hypotheses: every calibration-landmark pair separated by at least 32 px in both images
fit.refit: exact rational least squares, Q32 ties-to-even quantization, at most 8 consensus iterations

registration.transform_encoding: signed Q32 integers a,b,tx,ty for x'=a*x-b*y+tx; y'=b*x+a*y+ty

valid_support.base_margin_px: 0.5, exactly the erosion from pixel-cell footprint to bilinear-valid centre domain
valid_support.registration_margin: maximum admitted held-out residual converted to source pixels and rounded upward to 1/256 px
valid_support.coordinate_margin_px: 1/256 for every non-reference input; zero for the exact identity reference
valid_support.comparison: exact arbitrary-precision integer inequalities against Q32 transforms

overlap.intersection: integer reference-grid centres valid in every input support
overlap.denominator: rectangle width * height; fixed once for every arm

output_mapping.forbidden: fitting, validating, shifting, cropping, or otherwise changing the mapping from a program output
output_mapping.site_map: apply the frozen Q32 similarity to each common-frame coordinate
output_mapping.retained_fov: count common-overlap integer centres inside the descriptor's valid output support divided by the one fixed denominator
output_mapping.post_render_check: actual output dimensions may only confirm or fail the frozen descriptor; they never rebuild the denominator or mapping

exact_output_geometry_gates.rotation: a>0 and abs(b)*2^62 <= a*1609782167177275, the downward Q62 quantization of tan(0.02 degree)
exact_output_geometry_gates.residual: input-only held-out RMS rounded upward in micropixels <=100000

failure_mapping.condition: missing, malformed, compressed, oriented, differently sized, or non-RGB16 input
landmark extraction, consensus, or held-out registration contract fails
valid supports have no non-empty common integer rectangle
the frozen overlap schema, hash, or implementation contract is absent or unknown
an arm lacks a pre-output, output-blind grid descriptor
the pre-output map exceeds an existing scale, rotation, or non-translation residual bar
a rendered product violates its frozen dimensions or mapping contract
mapped valid support retains less than 99.0% of the fixed overlap
unknown exception, unknown failure code, or bad count partition
